title: Integrated privacy, cybersecurity, equity, safety, and trust risk register
purpose: Scores inherent and residual risk, checks mitigation completeness, prioritizes overdue actions, and produces an accountable risk dashboard.
input: `Risks` sheet with risk_id, domain, description, likelihood, impact, control_effectiveness, owner, review_date, status, and decision_trigger.
outputs: Prioritized risk register, inherent and residual scores, overdue actions, domain heatmap, critical-risk list, and governance summary.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
